why: Every protocol, version and kind this stack declares, with who produces each kind and who reads it. The `protocol-inventory` gate compares this file against the real registries in both directions, because a prose inventory in a document is not checked by anything: docs/context.md claimed 36 files, 140 tests and 9 gates at the commit where the truth was 44, 177 and 11, and nothing noticed. `producedBy` and `readBy` are not machine-checkable; they are here so that adding a shape is a recorded act with a named consumer, which is the one thing the previous system never had to do.

protocols.subject: the agent id
protocols.producedBy: scripts/*.mjs deployments (a deployment opens the node before recording it)

protocols.subject: the task id
protocols.producedBy: src/task/commands.ts createTaskCommands (the only surface that produces task facts)
